verdict.rationale: Exa's search response schema documents per-result metadata including `publishedDate` (ISO timestamp) and `author` (exa-docs-37). Results carry URLs that Contents can be run against (exa-docs-35, exa-docs-44), date-based filtering is supported (exa-gh-9), and Answer and Deep Search return citations (exa-gh-8, exa-docs-46). missing for 10: an explicit `title` field in the evidenced response schema, any guarantee that returned URLs are canonical, and independent or hands-on corroboration of metadata accuracy.
